Name: BFAV Slimes
Author: asunai2
Description:
Long story short: BFAV slimes, regular and rainbow, and they make poop :D

In addition to converting them, I also made a bunch of new textures and slimes for the mod. There are 40 slime variants available at  Marnie's shop.

Some of them are regular slimes, other ones are cat slimes, some are rainbow slimes, so on and so forth. They all drop unique items: Slime drop,  Slime essence, and Slime Poop.

I was going to release this a year ago but never did...It's not 100% perfect, as some of the textures need some tweaking and work, but I figured I'd get this out there for other people to use.

Regular slimes base skins (But have been modified): https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5497  I received permission from the author to use their work through PM.

The cat slimes were taken from: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2058  with permission
granted over a year ago for me to convert them into a bfav animal.

I may eventually get the gumption to finish all of the sprites and fix everything to be perfect, but right now I don't have that so I figured I'd just release what I do have so people can enjoy them.

Downloads.Description: Main BFAV file with JS Asset files for the slime drops.
